description: A tuple set is parameter-free definable exactly when it is the realization set of a formula in the original language.
signature:
Set.empty_definable_iff.{u, v, w, u₁} {M : Type w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u₁}
  {s : Set (α → M)} : ∅.Definable L s ↔ ∃ φ, s = Set.ofPred φ.Realize
